Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans, building sizes, ages, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, plumbing, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and ADA compliance; connects condition data to instructional priorities and long-term capital planning (Chapters 3, Appendix A, Facilities Assessment).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 10+ years with methodology; includes capacity utilization by site, classroom, and grade; links projections to specific facility actions including new school construction and expansions; considers adaptive uses and community partnerships (Chapters 4, 5, Development Fee Justification Study).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational specifications are a core organizing principle; detailed program descriptions for all grade levels and specialized programs (CTE, SDC, arts, STEM, etc.); clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; facility projects respond directly to educational needs (Appendix B, Educational Specifications).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes references to outdoor play areas, playground equipment, and shade structures; some site drainage and stormwater management issues addressed; lacks districtwide data on green space, canopy cover, or comprehensive greening strategies; outdoor learning mentioned only in passing (Facility Master Plan, site plans, and project descriptions).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges some site infrastructure issues such as storm drainage and flooding; no comprehensive climate risk assessment or districtwide climate resilience strategies evident; limited mention of mitigation measures related to climate impacts (Facility Master Plan, Chapter 3).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes data on HVAC units, lighting types, and electrical systems; references to energy management systems and some energy efficiency upgrades; mentions security and technology system upgrades; lacks comprehensive districtwide energy resilience plan or detailed electrification and decarbonization strategies (Facilities Assessment, Mechanical and Electrical sections).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates for all projects with escalation and contingencies; clear prioritization framework linked to enrollment growth and facility needs; outlines multiple funding sources including local bonds, state programs, developer fees, and alternative financing; includes long-term financial sustainability considerations (Chapter 6, Financing, and Project Budgets).
